intro.text: Kenton's mother, a Darksider who married Lord Mastrell Praxton.

items.text: Her marriage to Praxton, a powerful Daysider sand master, broke with tradition. Of their children only Kenton tried to join the Diem, and some blamed her Darksider blood for the family's weak mastery.
Dynastic was her native tongue, and she taught it to Kenton; by the time of the attack on the Diem he had not heard anyone speak it for two years.
